steps.name: The Witch of Deceit
steps.objective: Eavesdrop on the conversation at the entrance to 「Amaranth Nova」, then press the [Complete Quest] button to finish the quest.

lines.text: (In the ruined temple of Amaranth Nova, now drained of color, Belial notices something on the ground and sighs.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Ah... I never imagined the God of Despair I spent so long cultivating would meet such an end...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Kaulini, it's a shame, but what can we do? Still, I'll look for a way to revive you in the Demon Realm.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: And if even that fails, what choice is there? I'll have to accept that this is where your story ends.
(Belial gathers the remains of black butterflies and fragments of a shattered weapon from the ground, then places them inside her mirror.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: What are you? A rabbit?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: There you are, demon of deceit.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: You've been watching me for a while now.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Hehe. You knew, and still went about your business so calmly.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I believe I asked who you were.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: My name is Daphne.
(At the sound of Daphne's name, Belial looks up in surprise and interest.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: That Daphne?

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Hehe. How amusing. A witch infamous even in the Demon Realm comes looking for me. So, what do you want?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: There is something I wish to do. I don't know whether you are aware, but to meet that old man... I need your help.
(Smiling brightly, Daphne steps closer to Belial and raises her staff to tap Belial lightly on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: And with that, you are the 'last' item on my list. I am honored, Belial...

steps.name: The Black Moon's Confession
steps.objective: Eavesdrop on the conversation in 「Nameless Place」 in 「Elysia」, then press the [Complete Quest] button to finish the quest.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You are here, Hilda.
(Hilda looks around and starts in surprise when she sees Hecate standing before her.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Hecate? Then this is... Elysia?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Didn't I die? Hecate, tell me. What happened...?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Forgive me for bringing you here without your permission.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Your soul should have ceased to exist, but the will of regeneration within you saved it.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Your body, however, was lost. It could not return.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Then what happened to that fool in Amaranth Nova? Was I no help after all?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You helped. Through %s's efforts and that child Iris' awakening, the Demon God Kaulini was defeated...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Thank goodness...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Your condition was exactly what Ouroboros, who joined forces with the old man, had wanted. To swallow your soul before it vanished...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Without even knowing what that would mean...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Ah, I should have borne Iris' burden myself... I should have freed you all from the burden of being witches sooner...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Too many souls have vanished because of my weakness and the old man's games.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: So when you threatened me and that fool... And demanded that Goddess Iris surrender her place as God of the Astral Realm...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I understand now... I'm sorry I was so angry with you.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I had some idea. That perhaps my world had already been destroyed.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Demon God Kaulini apparently couldn't sense it. She threw me into a timeline that no longer existed and seemed satisfied...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Now that I'm gone, that fool can rest easy too... You could have told me a little sooner... If this was how it was destined to end anyway.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: No... Your destiny is by no means hopeless.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: It has merely been cast behind a black veil, where no one can see...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Like Iris and that child...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Like you and me...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: And like all of you who tried to save a world of despair, even in timelines that had perished...
